questions.question: In this question, a statement is followed by two inferences numbered I and II. Based on the statement, you have to decide which of the inferences can be derived from the statement. (An inference is something which is not directly stated but can be derived from the given facts/information in the statement) Statement: The company has announced a new policy that employees who have been with the company for more than 5 years will receive a bonus at the end of the year. However, employees who have joined within the last 6 months are not eligible for this bonus. Inference: I. Employees who have been with the company from 6 months to 5 years are eligible for the bonus. II. Employees who have been with the company for more than 5 years will definitely receive the bonus this year.
questions.questionHtml:
In this question, a statement is followed by two inferences numbered I and II. Based on the statement, you have to decide which of the inferences can be derived from the statement. (An inference is something which is not directly stated but can be derived from the given facts/information in the statement)
Statement: The company has announced a new policy that employees who have been with the company for more than 5 years will receive a bonus at the end of the year. However, employees who have joined within the last 6 months are not eligible for this bonus.
Inference:
I. Employees who have been with the company from 6 months to 5 years are eligible for the bonus.

II. Employees who have been with the company for more than 5 years will definitely receive the bonus this year.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is a (Only II can be inferred)

Inference I: Employees who have been with the company from 6 months to 5 years are eligible for the bonus.

Inference II: Employees who have been with the company for more than 5 years will definitely receive the bonus this year.

Correct Answer: Only (II) can be inferred.

questions.questionHtml:
Read the following information and answer the question that follows.
Anita started practicing yoga every morning after seeing how much it improved her friend Ravi's health and well-being.

questions.solution:
The answer provided is that both (I) and (II) can be inferred,

The statement mentions that Anita started practicing yoga every morning after seeing the positive effects it had on Ravi's health and well-being.

I) Ravi has been practicing yoga regularly.

II) Yoga has positively impacted Ravi’s health and well-being.

Therefore, the correct answer is:

Both (I) and (II) can be inferred
